title: A pseudo-labeling approach for automated assignment of unlabeled proteins exceeding 100 amino acid residues.
authors: Niu, Xiaogang; Hou, Xianhui; Jin, Changwen
one_liner_zh: 该文开发了一种无需同位素标记的NMR自动化学位移归属方法，利用AI预测化学位移辅助模拟退火框架，虽以蛋白质结构解析为应用目标，但核心贡献在实验谱图归属而非结构计算建模本身，方法可借鉴于蛋白质结构相关研究。
abstract: In the era of AI-driven protein structure prediction, there is an urgent demand for rapid, accessible experimental approaches to validate computationally predicted structural models or to improve the accuracy of AI-based structure determination. As a key experimental technique for determining protein structures in solution, conventional biomolecular NMR spectroscopy relies heavily on proteins labeled with (13)C and (15)N isotopes, a requirement that entails high experimental costs, lengthy sample preparation times, and steep technical barriers, thereby limiting its broader application. Building on our previous work, we have developed a pseudo-labeling strategy for the automated resonance assignment of unlabeled proteins. Using high-field NMR spectrometers equipped with cryoprobes, we acquired natural-abundance (1)H-(13)C and (1)H-(15)N heteronuclear correlation spectra directly from unlabeled samples. By integrating predicted chemical shifts of H(N), H(alpha), (13)C(alpha), and (15)N from three complementary AI tools into an iterative simulated annealing framework with an alternating scoring scheme, our method effectively resolves severe cross-peak overlap during the automated assignment process by introducing heteronuclear dimensional constraints. This approach enables reliable automated backbone resonance assignment for unlabeled proteins exceeding 100 amino acid residues. We anticipate that this labeling-free strategy will lower the technical barrier to biomolecular NMR, enabling researchers without specialized NMR expertise to employ NMR spectroscopy in fundamental life science research and drug development.
abstract_zh: 在人工智能驱动的蛋白质结构预测时代，迫切需要快速、易操作的实验方法来验证计算预测的结构模型或提高基于AI的结构测定精度。作为在溶液中测定蛋白质结构的关键实验技术，传统生物分子核磁共振波谱法高度依赖以(13)C和(15)N同位素标记的蛋白质，这一要求带来了高昂的实验成本、冗长的样品制备时间以及陡峭的技术门槛，从而限制了其更广泛的应用。基于我们先前的工作，我们开发了一种用于未标记蛋白质自动共振分配的伪标记策略。利用配备低温探针的高场核磁共振波谱仪，我们直接从未标记样品中获取天然丰度的(1)H-(13)C和(1)H-(15)N异核相关谱。通过将来自三种互补AI工具预测的H(N)、H(alpha)、(13)C(alpha)和(15)N化学位移整合到具有交替评分方案的迭代模拟退火框架中，我们的方法通过引入异核维度约束，有效解决了自动分配过程中的严重交叉峰重叠问题。该方法能够对超过100个氨基酸残基的未标记蛋白质实现可靠的自动骨架共振分配。我们预期这种免标记策略将降低生物分子核磁共振的技术门槛，使不具备专业核磁共振知识的科研人员能够在基础生命科学研究和药物开发中应用核磁共振波谱法。
